%% Stellio resume template v1 — pdfLaTeX, single file, Overleaf-compatible.
%% Stellio fills the STELLIO:SLOT markers using only the macros defined below.
%% Edit layout here; edit content behaviour in rules/resume.md.
\documentclass[10pt]{article}

\usepackage[a4paper,margin=0.6in,top=0.5in,bottom=0.5in]{geometry}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage{charter}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{tabularx}
% pdfTeX only (Tectonic/XeTeX has no \pdfgentounicode and emits a Unicode text layer natively)
\ifdefined\pdfgentounicode\input{glyphtounicode}\pdfgentounicode=1\fi

\definecolor{accent}{HTML}{1F2A37}
\pagestyle{empty}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{0pt}
\raggedright

% Section headings: small caps, hairline rule
\titleformat{\section}{\large\scshape\color{accent}}{}{0pt}{}[\vspace{-6pt}\rule{\linewidth}{0.4pt}]
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{8pt}{5pt}

\setlist[itemize]{leftmargin=1.1em,label=\textbullet,itemsep=1pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt}

% ---- Stellio macros (the AI may use only these) ----
% \resumeHeader{Name}{Location}{Email}{Phone}{LinkedIn URL}{Other URL}
\newcommand{\resumeHeader}[6]{%
  \begin{center}
    {\LARGE\color{accent}#1}\\[3pt]
    \small #2 \,|\, \href{mailto:#3}{\detokenize{#3}} \,|\, #4 \,|\, \href{#5}{LinkedIn} \,|\, \href{#6}{\detokenize{#6}}
  \end{center}\vspace{-4pt}}
% \resumeSummary{text}
\newcommand{\resumeSummary}[1]{\section{Summary}\small #1}
% \resumeEntry{Title}{Dates}{Organisation}{Location}
\newcommand{\resumeEntry}[4]{%
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}X r@{}}
    \textbf{#1} & \small #2\\
    \textit{\small #3} & \textit{\small #4}
  \end{tabularx}\vspace{-2pt}}
% \resumeProject{Name}{Stack}{Dates}
\newcommand{\resumeProject}[3]{%
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}X r@{}}
    \textbf{#1} \,\textit{\small | #2} & \small #3
  \end{tabularx}\vspace{-2pt}}
\newenvironment{resumeItems}{\begin{itemize}\small}{\end{itemize}\vspace{2pt}}
\newcommand{\resumeItem}[1]{\item #1}
% \skillLine{Category}{comma-separated skills}
\newcommand{\skillLine}[2]{\small\textbf{#1:} #2\\}

\begin{document}

%% STELLIO:SLOT header
\resumeHeader{Firstname Lastname}{City, Country}{name@example.com}{+00 000 000000}{https://linkedin.com/in/example}{https://github.com/example}
%% STELLIO:END header

%% STELLIO:SLOT summary
\resumeSummary{Data engineer with 3 years building batch and streaming pipelines in Python and SQL.}
%% STELLIO:END summary

%% STELLIO:SLOT experience
\section{Experience}
\resumeEntry{Job Title}{Jan 2023 -- Present}{Company}{City, Country}
\begin{resumeItems}
  \resumeItem{Reduced report generation time from 2 hours to 10 minutes by rewriting SQL pipelines.}
\end{resumeItems}
%% STELLIO:END experience

%% STELLIO:SLOT projects
\section{Projects}
\resumeProject{Project Name}{Python, Docker}{Mar 2024 -- Jun 2024}
\begin{resumeItems}
  \resumeItem{What it does, your role, and the outcome.}
\end{resumeItems}
%% STELLIO:END projects

%% STELLIO:SLOT skills
\section{Skills}
\skillLine{Languages}{Python, SQL}
\skillLine{Tools}{Docker, Git}
%% STELLIO:END skills

%% STELLIO:SLOT education
\section{Education}
\resumeEntry{B.Sc. Computer Science}{Sep 2019 -- Jun 2023}{University}{City, Country}
%% STELLIO:END education

%% STELLIO:SLOT certifications
%% STELLIO:END certifications

\end{document}
